signals.quote: Good, because that's the part I'm here for.
What does this look like at 500 seats? I need total cost, not list price. Implementation, support tier, the real number.
We start renewal planning for our other vendors in April and this either fits in that cycle or waits a year.
What's your pricing model when seats fluctuate? We're seasonal. I don't want to pay January rates for July headcount.
Does the audit trail export? We report on reconciliation exceptions quarterly.
Priya's team will want to see the SSO flow before we sign anything. She runs engineering and she's strict about auth.
I'd like to get a sandbox going with our real schemas next.

commitments.what: put together a full ROI breakdown, real cost against the hours you're losing
run a session with Priya's team to show the SSO flow
make sure the breakdown models your seasonality
have Sam set up a sandbox with real schemas
